tools.name: hydracept_workspace_status
tools.description: Check workspace/session authentication and readiness, plus common setup errors. Use when setup, auth, or project binding is in doubt; use hydracept_job_status for a specific execution. Does not execute capabilities or spend money. Hosted requires bearer (WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED when missing); stdio checks local project binding. Not a substitute for hydracept_capabilities. Returns: Workspace/session authentication and readiness diagnostics for the authenticated principal. Errors: WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED when bearer is missing on hosted MCP.

refresh.title: Refresh
refresh.description: Stdio: when true, also verify session over the network. Ignored on hosted MCP.

tools.name: hydracept_capabilities
tools.description: Browse or fetch capability descriptors (keys, modes, schemas). Use hydracept_resolve_capability when routing from intent alone. List/resolve is keyless; a bearer key may add project-scoped fields. No charge. Read-only. Returns: Capability list or single CapabilityDescriptor when key is set. Errors: NOT_FOUND for unknown key; INVALID_ARGUMENT for conflicting query parameters.

key.title: Key
key.description: Optional capability key for GET /v1/capabilities/{key}. When set, query is ignored.

query.title: Query
query.description: Optional search string when key is empty. Hosted: always POST /v1/capabilities/resolve (keyless). Stdio: resolve when authenticated, else list filtering.

tools.name: hydracept_resolve_capability
tools.description: Match the user's goal to a capability key using natural language. Use when the key is unknown; use hydracept_capabilities when you already have a key or need the catalog. Keyless. No charge. Read-only. Returns: CapabilityResolutionResponse with ranked keys and rationale. Errors: INVALID_ARGUMENT when intent is empty; UNAUTHORIZED when bearer is invalid.

intent.title: Intent
intent.description: Required string: user goal in natural language (passed verbatim to the resolver).

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.description: Optional object matching CapabilityResolutionRequest.requirements (e.g. modality tags). Default {}. runnableNow requires an authenticated project workspace on the API.

tools.name: hydracept_quote_capability
tools.description: Preview what a run would cost — does not execute, create a job, or charge the wallet. Use before spending when the user asks about price; use hydracept_run or hydracept_submit_job only to execute. Not the same as request_capability_quote (POST /mcp/full) on the full profile (human-paid capability commission). Requires bearer API key. No charge for the quote itself. Returns: Quote envelope with customerTotal and currency (no wallet charge). Errors: WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED, INVALID_ARGUMENT, NOT_FOUND, FundingRequired when quote cannot be priced.

capability_key.title: Capability Key
capability_key.description: Required capability registry key unless only legacy aliases are passed.

body.title: Body
body.description: Invocation payload object validated against the capability schema.

input.title: Input
input.description: Alias for body; do not pass both.

tools.name: hydracept_run
tools.description: Run a capability (paid). Use when the user wants execution — not for quotes (hydracept_quote_capability), status (hydracept_job_status), or receipts (hydracept_get_receipt). Default wait=true waits until the job finishes; use hydracept_submit_job when this call must return immediately. Picks invoke vs durable job from the capability descriptor. Requires bearer key. Settles at actual provider cost plus any managed service fee; no per-call minimum. May create jobs, artifacts, and provider usage. Returns: Terminal hydracept.run-result.v1 or job envelope when wait=false. Errors: WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED, INVALID_ARGUMENT, FundingRequired, EXECUTION_FAILED, job timeout when wait exhausts.

capability_key.title: Capability Key
capability_key.description: Required capability registry key for POST .../jobs.

body.title: Body
body.description: Required capability input object (schema fields). Merged with session project context when bound.

wait.title: Wait
wait.description: Boolean, default true. When true, poll until succeeded/failed/canceled or timeout. When false, return job id and poll with hydracept_job_status.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds to poll when wait=true; omit to poll until terminal with no tool-side limit (the MCP client request timeout may end the call first). On timeout, status may stay running — call hydracept_job_status.

max_cost.title: Max Cost
max_cost.description: Optional number (USD): sets execution.executionConstraints.maxCostUsd before submit.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Optional string; server generates run-{uuid} when empty. Reuse for safe retries.

input.title: Input
input.description: Alias for body; do not pass both.

tools.name: hydracept_submit_job
tools.description: Start a capability job and return its id immediately (paid). Use when execution is required but this MCP call must not block — not for quotes or status checks. Prefer hydracept_run when waiting is acceptable. Poll with hydracept_job_status. Same billing as hydracept_run. Requires bearer key. Returns: Job admission envelope with jobId and nextAction poll. Errors: WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED, INVALID_ARGUMENT, FundingRequired, EXECUTION_FAILED.

body.title: Body
body.description: Capability input object; merged with session project context when bound.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Optional string; server generates job-{uuid} when empty.

tools.name: hydracept_job_status
tools.description: Read one job's current status. Use after hydracept_submit_job or hydracept_run with wait=false; use hydracept_get_receipt after success. If the job id is unknown, use hydracept_jobs_find first. Requires bearer key. No charge. Returns: HydraceptJob status projection for the jobId. Errors: WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED, NOT_FOUND.

job_id.title: Job Id
job_id.description: Required job id from hydracept_run or hydracept_submit_job.

tools.name: hydracept_cancel_job
tools.description: Request cancellation of one job. Use only when the user explicitly asks to cancel the job itself; stopping a local polling loop is not a cancellation. Returns whether the request was accepted, whether the job is already terminal, and the next action. Never promise that upstream provider work stopped or that already-incurred cost is refunded. Safe to retry: a terminal job reports its terminal state. Requires bearer key. Returns: Cancellation outcome envelope with job status, terminal flag, and next action. Errors: WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED, NOT_FOUND, INVALID_ARGUMENT.

job_id.title: Job Id
job_id.description: Required job id to cancel. Use hydracept_jobs_find if the id is unknown.

tools.name: hydracept_get_receipt
tools.description: Read billing and provenance for a finished job. Does not run capabilities or spend money. Use after terminal success; use hydracept_job_status while still running. Hosted MCP accepts job_id only. Requires bearer key. No charge. Returns: HydraceptReceipt JSON for a terminal job. Errors: WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED, NOT_FOUND when job or receipt is missing.

job_id.title: Job Id
job_id.description: Job or execution id for GET /v1/jobs/{jobId}/receipt. Required on hosted MCP.

tools.name: hydracept_download_artifact
tools.description: Fetch artifact metadata (and SHA-256 on hosted MCP) for a succeeded job output. Stdio may also write bytes when output_path is set. Requires bearer key. No charge on hosted. Returns: Artifact downloadUrl, mediaType, sha256 (hosted does not write local files). Errors: WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED, NOT_FOUND, DIRECTORY_CAPABILITY_DENIED when policy blocks.

job_id.title: Job Id
job_id.description: Required owning job id (scopes the artifact download URL).

artifact_id.title: Artifact Id
artifact_id.description: Required artifact id from job artifacts or run result.

tools.name: hydracept_jobs_find
tools.description: Find a prior job in the bound project when you do not have its id. intent is recent, failed, or reusable. The list never includes prompt text. Use after context loss, for failure triage, or to recover a job to cancel. Requires bearer key. No charge. Read-only. Returns: Matching job summaries for the filter. Errors: WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED, INVALID_ARGUMENT.

intent.title: Intent
intent.description: Optional search scope: recent (default), failed, or reusable.

capability_key.title: Capability Key
capability_key.description: Optional capability key to narrow the search.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Optional maximum number of matching jobs (1-100, default 10).

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Hosted only: bound project id; omit to use the session-bound project.
